pixr — project notes for Claude

Source: CLAUDE.md

R package: tidyverse-style client for the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) PIX Open Data API (Olinda / OData). Returns tibbles. Python counterpart: ../pixbr (PyPI). Sibling package with the canonical author metadata: ../alepe.

  • Repo: https://github.com/StrategicProjects/pixr (public, branch main).
  • CRAN: 0.1.0 published; 0.1.1 submitted 2026-10-28 (in incoming/pretest). After acceptance: tag v0.1.1, delete CRAN-SUBMISSION.
  • Docs site: https://strategicprojects.github.io/pixr/ — GitHub Pages, deployed by .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml to the gh-pages branch. docs/ is NOT tracked on main (gitignored). The old monitoramento.pe.gov.br/pixr host never resolved; don’t reintroduce it.

Endpoints (6 since 0.1.1)

Endpoint Param Function
ChavesPix Data (YYYY-MM-DD) get_pix_keys()
TransacoesPixPorMunicipio DataBase (YYYYMM) get_pix_transactions_by_municipality()
EstatisticasTransacoesPix Database (YYYYMM) get_pix_transaction_stats()
EstatisticasFraudesPix Database (YYYYMM) get_pix_fraud_stats()
CnaePorteRecebedor Database (YYYYMM) get_pix_cnae_stats()
PixUsuariosCadastradosDICT (none) get_pix_dict_users()
  • All data is monthly (DICT users series: one obs per month-end since 2020-11). No daily data in this API.
  • Gotcha: on CnaePorteRecebedor and the municipality endpoint, Database selects the data snapshot, not the month — responses mix several AnoMes. Filter with AnoMes eq YYYYMM for a single month.
  • To check for new endpoints, fetch the OData $metadata and diff EntityType/FunctionImport against pix_endpoints().

Delicate parts

  • URL building (R/client.R pix_request()): the BCB API is picky — only spaces are percent-encoded (%20), nothing else. curl handles raw UTF-8 in filters (accents work). Don’t switch to standard URL encoding.
  • skip is not supported by the API → warn and omit.
  • cli pluralization: {?s} needs a quantity expression before it in the same string, or cli_warn/cli_abort throws (this bit us once in validate_columns()).
  • BCB URLs (olinda.bcb.gov.br) return 403 to bots but 200 in browsers; CRAN accepted them — keep the note in cran-comments.md.
  • pkgdown: every vignette must appear in the articles: index of _pkgdown.yml (navbar menu alone is not enough; the site build fails).

Dev workflow

roxygen2::roxygenise()
devtools::test()        # 87 offline tests; nothing hits the API
devtools::check()       # 0/0/0 expected
devtools::build(path = ".")   # CRAN tarball
devtools:::upload_cran(devtools::as.package("."), "pixr_X.Y.Z.tar.gz")

CI: .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml (5 platforms; macOS arm64 runners sometimes fail with “job was not acquired” — GitHub capacity, just rerun) and pkgdown.yaml.

Conventions

  • Author list and order are canonical in ../alepe/DESCRIPTION (Leite, Wasiliew, Vasconcelos, Amorim, Bezerra, Nascimento Barreto, all with ORCIDs). Keep pixr/pixbr aligned.
  • Examples hitting the API use \donttest{} (or \dontrun{} for pix_ping/pix_query) — CRAN reviewer required this in 0.1.0.
  • Vignettes use eval = FALSE with real captured output pasted as #> comments; refresh outputs against the live API when touching them.
